answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the forge of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, weighted by independent path length, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. A island of per-task receipts records who did what, and the canyon of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it.
